const doc=`# SK-01–SK-06 source discovery (iteration 1)

## Scope and decision state

Fixed-source, source-only discovery at dispatch parent \`${rev}\` for the six original SK rows in the registered task card. At that pinned execution-state source, SK-01–SK-06 remain \`pending\`, each has empty retained evidence and \`needs_fixed_scope_discovery\`. This report does not change formal state, reproduce an old business validator, qualify a requirement, or establish runtime behavior. It does not alter batch counts, ownership, gates, or other audit rows.

The requirements are grounded in \`docs/reviews/20260908-full-product-audit/01-inventory-governance.md:75-80\`; the related GOV-01–03 findings are at lines 28–30. Exact Chinese action/acceptance and future evidence are retained in the task card. Source implementation is separated below from historical findings and proposed contract questions.

## Shared source ownership and dependencies

The six canonical project skills are tracked under \`.teams/skills\`. In this tree, five Claude and Codex mirror directories are tracked symlinks into those canonical folders; \`xai-consistency-audit\` is a regular file copy whose blob matches the canonical skill. The seven relevant Cursor rules are independent tracked files. The blanket symlink claim in \`docs/workflow/project/usage-guide.md:99\` is stale for the consistency-audit exception. The dashboard generator checks mirror path presence; this does not establish mirror content identity. No mirror or registry is changed here.

The shared full-loop contract’s portable owner is \`docs/workflow/_portable/04-automation-loop.md\`; the roadmap contract’s owner is \`docs/workflow/_portable/06-roadmap-orchestration.md\`. Project skills are rendered from those upstream appendices. A shared change must use the declared portable generation/resync path and account for project overlays, Claude/Codex rules, Cursor rules, and Handoff tracking. Feature-brief names \`03-step0-brief-spec.md\` as its canonical schema until a project overlay exists. The dossier PRD schema is inside \`xai-feature-dossier-sync\`; it requires source evidence and test IDs but has no stable feature-ID field.

GOV-01–03 are shared dependencies: G01 is dev-log format discovery/parse visibility; G02 is roadmap manifest discovery and state-to-Target reconciliation; G03 is source/generated identity coverage plus freshness/current verification range. SK-05 consumes these contracts and must not fork their parser work. GOV-05 is a single nine-feature dossier audit card, not nine new SK rows. SK-01/SK-06 must share its dossier schema/writer and preserve the no-code-only-source rule; neither authorizes a second PRD writer or changes GOV-05 state.

## Six original item matrices

### SK-01 — brief identity and failure/recovery acceptance

**Original card row.** P2: \`xai-feature-brief\` fixes \`feature_id\`, scope, and failure/recovery acceptance; later dossier and iterations must trace to the original brief. Status pending; evidence empty.

**Pinned-source evidence and gap.** Feature-brief already collects scope/non-goals, risk, testable acceptance, and QA gate; recovery is addressed when applicable. Portable Step 0 explicitly reserves canonical feature-slug selection to feature-plan (\`03-step0-brief-spec.md:265+\`). Dossier requires a real \`Source:\` per requirement and traces acceptance criteria to test IDs, but its schema has no stable feature-ID field. This is an identity handoff gap, not proof of a runtime defect.

**Bounded proposal / candidate owner files.** Owner must decide whether \`feature_id\` is distinct from, aliases, or derives from the canonical slug; where it is assigned; and how renames preserve references. Then carry one key plus scope, non-goals, and applicable failure/recovery acceptance brief → dossier source/requirement → each iteration. Keep slug choice with feature-plan unless the owner revises the portable boundary; keep unknown facts TBD and prohibit code-only source inference. Candidate sources: \`.teams/skills/xai-feature-brief/SKILL.md\`, \`.agents/templates/feature-plan.md\`, \`.teams/skills/xai-feature-dossier-sync/SKILL.md\`; edit portable \`03\` only if the shared schema itself changes, then render/resync. Mirror impact includes platform links and Cursor rule.

**Future evidence/fixtures.** Owner-reviewed key semantics; source-bound before/after contract; fixtures for key survival across rename, scope/non-goal carried across multiple iterations, missing source/key, and applicable versus TBD failure/recovery. None ran here.

### SK-02 — phase Target, commit, verification receipt, closeout

**Original card row.** P2: \`xai-feature-full-loop\` emits Target/commit/verification receipt per phase; closeout checks registry parsing and dossier delta, not merely package status. Pending; evidence empty.

**Pinned-source evidence and gap.** Full-loop reads package \`dev_log.md\` between workers and reports Status Panel/workers/blockers/next step. Portable build template records phase commit/test/work log; verify has its own verdict contract. The parent loop output does not define a normalized per-phase Target/commit/verification receipt or registry-parse+dossier-delta closeout. The exact registry authority/path must be approved; no registry name is guessed.

**Bounded proposal / candidate owner files.** Bind stable feature/Target/iteration to exact commit(s), scoped verification evidence/result, and the same iteration’s status record; closeout reconciles the authorized registry parse and dossier requirement delta against that receipt, surfacing missing or ambiguous links. Keep human ship and independent verification separate; package Status alone is not completion. Candidate shared owner: \`docs/workflow/_portable/04-automation-loop.md\` and generated \`.teams/skills/xai-feature-full-loop/SKILL.md\`, plus \`feature-auto-build.md\` / \`feature-verify.md\`; dossier writer remains \`xai-feature-dossier-sync\`. Coordinate with GOV-01–03 before naming registry writer.

**Future evidence/fixtures.** Two Targets in one package with separate commits; missing/duplicate Target; receipt tied to wrong commit; parse failure; omitted dossier delta; READY_TO_SHIP without human ship action. No stage, dispatch, worker, registry parse, dossier update, or skill action ran.

### SK-03 — roadmap schema and current Target identity

**Original card row.** P2: \`xai-roadmap-loop\` uses unified manifest schema and checks corresponding Target; emit/serial must not display stale iteration state. Pending; evidence empty.

**Pinned-source evidence and gap.** Portable A6 has slug/source/dependencies/status/automation mode/cross-vendor setting/last run/note (\`06-roadmap-orchestration.md:220-273\`), but no stable Target/iteration identity plus commit/verification receipt. The skill reconciles manifest queue state against \`dev_log\` while keeping roadmap writes separate from package Status Panel. The three actual AI-tool manifest examples show concrete consumer formats; GOV-02’s historical finding describes table-header parsing that misses no-table-header forms. Manifest state and package iteration state are separate facts.

**Bounded proposal / candidate owner files.** Define Target/iteration identity and evidence fields sufficient to reconcile the exact row to the exact package iteration. Preserve manifest queue semantics and the no-package-Status-writer boundary. Surface disagreement with paths/IDs rather than silently rewriting another owner’s record. Candidate shared owner: \`docs/workflow/_portable/06-roadmap-orchestration.md\`, rendered \`.teams/skills/xai-roadmap-loop/SKILL.md\`, and roadmap consumers; coordinate parser discovery with GOV-02 and receipts with SK-02.

**Future evidence/fixtures.** Optional table header; duplicate/missing Target; multiple iterations in one package; manifest older than a newer iteration; emit and serial preserving owned fields. No roadmap command, emit, serial dispatch, or manifest write ran.

### SK-04 — release record type versus product/deployment health

**Original card row.** P2: \`xai-release-log\` distinguishes change_kind/source commit/deployed commit/environment/artifact; doc-only updates must not change product-verification health; SHIPPED is not deploy. Pending; evidence empty.

**Pinned-source evidence and gap.** Skill/log use product line, branch/commit, user/developer delta, free-text Verification, and risks; they prohibit invented verification and calling documentation shipped. Dashboard \`release-testing.mjs\` classifies free text as pass/fail/partial/unknown. There is no explicit typed separation of documentation verification from product health or joined source/deployment receipt fields. This is a schema gap, not proof of incorrect current output.

**Bounded proposal / candidate owner files.** Owner defines change-kind vocabulary and fields required by each kind. Bind source commit to documented delta; bind deployment receipt to deployed commit, environment, immutable artifact identity. Keep docs checks distinct from product runtime health and SHIPPED distinct from deployment. Do not infer enum or health rules from regex implementation. Candidate: \`.teams/skills/xai-release-log/SKILL.md\`, \`release-log.md\`, dashboard parser/consumer \`scripts/dashboard/release-testing.mjs\`, \`generate-state.mjs\`, and relevant contract/template consumer.

**Future evidence/fixtures.** Doc-only with passing documentation check; runtime failure; SHIPPED-not-deployed; mismatched deployment commit/artifact/environment; missing receipt. No release-log edit or deployment check ran.

### SK-05 — source/generated coverage and verification range

**Original card row.** P2: \`xai-dev-dashboard-sync\` asserts source/generated-set coverage; omissions/conflicts/current-commit verification range visible and linked to GOV-01–03. Pending; evidence empty.

**Pinned-source evidence and gap.** Dashboard contract separates authored \`dashboard-state.json\` decisions and generated facts; generator reads Git, roadmaps, skills/agents, docs, release logs, and dev logs. Skill registry carries explicit/generated field notes and counts, which are not source/emitted identity equality. \`listSkillSet\` silently omits absent paths and mirror status checks presence, not content identity. No discovered/parsed/emitted/unparsed/duplicate/conflicting identity sets or per-item verified-commit range are emitted. Snapshot freshness is not source coverage. UI consumes generated skill registry and Testing Registry separately; static verifier has freshness/release checks but was not run.

**Bounded proposal / candidate owner files.** Inventory finite source sets and authoritative keys first; expose discovered/parsed/emitted/unparsed/duplicate/conflict sets with paths and exact verification range/commit. Report snapshot freshness separately from identity coverage and verification. Unknown formats remain visible. SK-05 consumes GOV-01/02 parser/discovery contracts and adds coverage/freshness boundaries for GOV-03; do not duplicate parser work. Candidate: \`.teams/skills/xai-dev-dashboard-sync/SKILL.md\`, \`generate-state.mjs\`, \`verify-static.mjs\` as consumer only, \`dev-dashboard.md\`, \`dashboard-state.json\`, and UI/template/boundary consumers including \`skill-agent.js\`.

**Future evidence/fixtures.** Missing source, duplicate identity, conflicting mirror, malformed format, stale snapshot, clean snapshot with unparsed source, and verification receipt against older commit; define single source-set authority and single generated-registry writer first. No generator/parser/verifier/import/refresh ran.

### SK-06 — stable ID across records and split findings

**Original card row.** P2: \`xai-consistency-audit\` links stable IDs bidirectionally through PRD/package/test/deploy; code problems and record drift receive separate evidence. Pending; evidence empty.

**Pinned-source evidence and gap.** Skill separates read-only detection, confirmation-before-apply, \`code_violation\`, \`record_drift\`, and \`needs-operator\`, with path/line evidence. Current checks reconcile dashboard/PRD/package/dev-log presence/status; \`consistency-checks.json\` enumerates ghost/missing/status/cross-surface/PRD-code mismatch. PRD traces acceptance to test IDs but has no stable feature ID; no bidirectional map binds PRD requirement, package, Target/iteration, test result, and deployment receipt. Code violations remain routed to feature workflow; record drift remains record-only.

**Bounded proposal / candidate owner files.** After SK-01 identity and GOV-05 dossier ownership are decided, define a stable-ID map across PRD requirement/revision, package(s), Target/iteration, test ID/result, and release/deploy receipt. Each edge identifies source and direction; surface missing/ambiguous/conflicting links. Preserve finding classes and write authorities; never infer a new requirement from implementation or auto-edit code, priority, release, deploy, roadmap. Candidate: \`.teams/skills/xai-consistency-audit/SKILL.md\`, \`consistency-checks.json\`, \`module-classification.json\` only for boundary authority, \`dashboard-state.json\`, and shared SK-01/02/04/GOV-05 schemas.

**Future evidence/fixtures.** PRD-only/package-only, missing/duplicate ID, one feature with multiple packages, missing test, deploy mismatch, code violation with source path/line versus record drift across records. No consistency report or apply action ran.

## Shared future contract and holds

The narrow next design decision is owner review of: stable ID versus canonical slug; Target/iteration receipt; source-set authority and coverage output; change-kind/deployment vocabulary; dossier mapping and writer ownership. Candidate files above identify source ownership, not write authorization. Cross-platform tracked-surface and portable render impacts need a finite path matrix before any change. Any future packet should bind before/after source hashes, exact paths, representative fixtures, and assertions to each original SK row; share GOV-05 dossier writer and reconcile GOV-01–03 rather than duplicate or close them.

Unresolved: owner decision on ID semantics, receipt schema, enum vocabulary, source-set authority, and shared writer. No independent review, implementation, runtime, test, mirror regeneration, qualification, deploy, remote sync, or root admission evidence exists in this discovery. Do not mark items complete, accepted, implementation-ready, or qualified.
